name: Aun Settlement (Menhir Ring)
title: Aun Settlement
summary: A small Aun Tumerok settlement (Aun Tikakhe, Saritea, Aulakhe - Buadren and Invoker quests) at 82.7N 21.0E around a Menhir Ring holding one of the Menhir Research mana fields. The kit shows the ring: four 3.7 m menhirs and four 2.9 m stones in two circles around four metal sculptures and a burning torch, a wooden longhouse with fish, cups and a lantern, four green tents around a campfire (Akiekie Ember / Hot Air), and the Entrance to Portal Space swirl 45 m north-east.
